findings: Staff mutations are local-state-only — handleInvite, toggleStatus, and removeMember mutate staffList in memory only. No API call is made to POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/hotels/:id/staff. A page refresh resets all changes. Wire mutations to the API or mark buttons as coming soon.

Revenue trend bucketed by checkIn, not checkOut — analytics/page.tsx groups revenue by b.checkIn.slice(0, 10). Revenue is earned at checkout; using check-in date skews the chart for multi-night stays. Change to b.checkOut.slice(0, 10).

No build log covers HEAD commit — checkout-build.log predates b64cf71 by over an hour. No npx next build output exists to confirm the current codebase compiles without TypeScript errors. A passing build log must be committed alongside the feature commit.
